architectureDecisions: Digest spec (sha256 over canonicalJson from packages/agent-tools/src/run-trace.js: canonical key sort, undefined dropped): taskDigest = sha256(canonicalJson({id, repositoryRoot: resolve(repositoryRoot), baseRevision, prompt, verifications: [{name, command, args, timeoutMs}], requiredFiles: requiredFiles ?? []})) — the ORIGINAL canonical task exactly as validateAgentTask (packages/agent-tools/src/supervisor.js) returns it; declaredContextDigest = sha256(canonicalJson({taskId, baseRevision, requiredFiles: requiredFiles ?? [], maxMaterializedBytes})); materializedContextDigest = sha256(canonicalJson({items: items.map(({path, sourceRef, snapshotRef, contentSha256: sha256(content)})), promptPrefixDigest: sha256(promptPrefix)})) from resolveAgentTaskContext (packages/agent-tools/src/task-context.js) — used:false maps to {items: [], promptPrefixDigest: sha256('')}; executionDigest = sha256(canonicalJson({model: model ?? null, permissionProfile, maxAttempts, maxFeedbackChars, timeoutMs, toolVersion})). Never hash or persist credential values: env is excluded from every digest and from the handle body.

Versioned handle compatibility: packages/agent-tools/src/recovery.js exports AGENT_TOOL_RUN_HANDLE_V2; the handle body gains taskDigest, declaredContextDigest, materializedContextDigest, executionDigest and binds them inside handleDigest. runRecoverableTask persists the V2 binding before first dispatch via persistRecoverableHandle. resumeSupervisedTask recomputes all four digests from the resupplied task, agentContext and launch params and rejects any mismatch with RecoveryError CONTRACT_DRIFT before reopening the worktree or spawning a process; no same-id fallback. Model and permissionProfile are launch fields carried in the tool invocation request (agentToolEnvironment in packages/agent-tools/src/tool-adapters.js) and are bound in executionDigest, so changed model/permission is drift, not an upgrade. Tool version is re-probed at resume (probeToolVersion) and must equal handle.toolVersion.

Configurable-limit policy and migration: resume launch params must equal the persisted binding — model, permissionProfile, maxAttempts, maxFeedbackChars, timeoutMs and toolVersion byte-match the V2 executionDigest inputs; resolvedMaxAttempts may not exceed handle.maxAttempts. Legacy AGENT_TOOL_RUN_HANDLE_V1 handles fail closed with RecoveryError LEGACY_HANDLE carrying the migration instruction: 'AGENT_TOOL_RUN_HANDLE_V1 predates exact contract binding: dispose the legacy handle (disposeRecoverableRun) and re-dispatch via runSupervisedTask to mint a V2 binding; never backfill binding fields onto a legacy handle.' Unchanged bindings retain worktreeRoot, coreSessionId and toolSessionRef (initialSessionRef continues the same tool session, one semantic attempt); deliver-slice maps LEGACY_HANDLE to a quiet dispose plus slice reason LEGACY_HANDLE without resuming.
implementationSlices: S1 — Pin contract/API and execute the discriminating prototype in the research brief; proposed future implementation files are not claimed to exist. Executed unchanged/drift probes (node /tmp/probe-bb125.mjs, all PASS, see researchProbes): P1 unchanged write->read->verify roundtrip retains digest; P2 tampered body -> DIGEST_MISMATCH; P3 same-id changed prompt/verifier passes today's resume identity check (drift accepted — the documented gap, since the check compares only id/repositoryRoot/baseRevision); P4 current handle body carries no prompt/verifier/model/permissionProfile binding; P5 declared-context vs materialized-context digests are distinct stable 64-hex sha256; P6 model/permission change alters the composite execution digest. Binding schema: taskDigest/declaredContextDigest/materializedContextDigest/executionDigest over canonicalJson.

S2 — After fresh READY, implement only the declared seam and focused positive/negative fixtures: add the four digest fields plus AGENT_TOOL_RUN_HANDLE_V2 to packages/agent-tools/src/recovery.js (createAgentToolRunHandle/assertHandleBody/handleDigest), persist them in runRecoverableTask and revalidate them in resumeSupervisedTask (packages/agent-tools/src/supervisor.js), map LEGACY_HANDLE in packages/agent-tools/src/deliver-slice.js.
S3 — Run focused regressions, bind independent evidence and reconcile Living descriptions before Worker judgment.
